paragraphs: QQQ is -0.65% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -44/100 (Cautiously Negative). Score path: pre-market -32 → now -44; open -65 → now -44 (improved 21 points).

QQQ and its internal leadership are diverging, so the index move has weaker confirmation (semiconductors mixed, mega-caps negative, breadth mixed).
